verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a consumer chat platform like Discord, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The only nearby item covers Social SDK social settings for players, which is a different feature, and the community items on age verification and breaches do not address telemetry controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
